message.content: It depends on what you’re looking for—genre, critical acclaim, or audience reception—but many critics and audiences agree that **“Parasite”** (2019) was still dominating discussions into 2020, especially after its historic Oscar wins. If you’re looking for something more recent from 2020 itself, **“Tenet”** (2020) was a high‑profile release that sparked a lot of conversation, though opinions were mixed. For a critically acclaimed 2020 film, **“Nomadland”** (2020) received widespread praise and won several awards, including Best Picture at the Oscars.
